$comment: Advisories the dependency audit tolerates, each on named install paths only, with a reason and an expiry after which the audit fails again. Read by scripts/audit.mjs; add an entry only when no fixed version exists and the code path cannot see untrusted input.

exceptions.reason: Bundled inside aws-cdk-lib 2.271.0 (the latest release, 2026-09-30), so no override or upgrade can replace it. CDK runs it at synth time over the repository's own asset globs; it never sees untrusted input and never ships in the application image.
